title: feat(client,runtime): auth.mePermissions() reads GET /auth/me/permissions as MePermissionsResponse
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFC6SL3DC5erhU84B8GXB6y)_

Fixes #28709

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new SDK method, `client.auth.mePermissions()`, over the existing `GET /auth/me/permissions`. No wire change, no new route, and no `packages/spec/**` file is touched.

Metadata-protocol: none — nothing a metadata author writes is read differently; the method reads a response body already declared in `@objectstack/spec/api` by PR #28704.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@objectstack/client` 多了一个方法 `client.auth.mePermissions()`,读当前用户的有效权限(`GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions`),返回类型就是 spec 里已声明的 `MePermissionsResponse`;未登录时返回 `{ authenticated: false }`,不抛错。路由台账给这条路由补了一行。
- 为什么改:#28704 已把这个响应体在 spec 里严格声明,但 SDK 没有方法,下一个读权限的功能(例如 #28428 的队列开关)只能再手写一次裸 fetch。没有台账行时,SDK 的 URL 一致性门禁不认这个方法(只命中 `* /auth/**` 通配行)。
- 风险与回滚:纯加法:一个新方法、一行台账、一个 dogfood 门禁的豁免条目。线上行为不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` 新行(说明它由 plugin-hono-server 的 raw app 提供,不经 `dispatch()`);`packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts` 的新豁免条目;`packages/client/src/index.ts` 的 `mePermissions`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/client exec vitest run src/auth-me-permissions.test.ts src/client-url-conformance.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 6 passed (6)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/client/src/index.ts`**: `auth.mePermissions()` resolves `MePermissionsResponse`; it GETs `${baseUrl}${getRoute('auth')}/me/permissions` through the shared fetch wrapper. The type is imported from `@objectstack/spec/api`, not restated. Its JSDoc says how it differs from `auth.me()`: a signed-out caller resolves `{ authenticated: false }` (the route answers that at 200) rather than rejecting.
- **`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`**: a `GET /auth/me/permissions` row (`domain: '/auth'`, `disposition: 'sdk'`, `client: 'auth.mePermissions'`, `responseSchema: 'MePermissionsResponseSchema'`). Exact rows sort ahead of the `* /auth/**` family in `client-url-conformance`, so the method is credited to this row and not to the wildcard. The note states what serves it: plugin-hono-server's `registerCurrentUserEndpoints` with `rawApp.get()`, ahead of plugin-auth's catch-all, not `dispatch()` (the `/auth` domain only relays to the auth service, which does not serve this path). It names the suite that gives the `responseSchema` its conformance coverage: `current-user-endpoints-has-any-queue.test.ts` drives this handler and parses every body it provokes through the strict schema. The census sentence was regenerated (`check-route-ledger-census.mjs --fix`: 115 → 116).
- **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`**: `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` joins `UNEXERCISED_BY_THIS_BOOT`, with its reason. A raw-app mount never passes through the `IHttpServer` port, so without the pin direction 1 ("every ledgered route is reachably mounted") would red on this row. Dogfood does not run in PR CI, so a missing pin would only show up on `main`.
- **`.changeset/28709-client-auth-me-permissions.md`**: `@objectstack/client` patch with both declaration lines. `Metadata-protocol: none` grades every entry `patch` (`check-changeset-no-major`). `route-ledger.ts` ships in no package: `ROUTE_LEDGER` / `LEGACY_CHAIN_PREFIXES` get 0 hits in `packages/runtime/dist` (control `createDispatcherPlugin` hits `dist/index.js`), and dogfood is private.

## Tests

- New `packages/client/src/auth-me-permissions.test.ts` (3 cases) runs over the **real handler**. plugin-hono-server's `registerCurrentUserEndpoints` is mounted on `new HonoHttpServer(0).getRawApp()`, the app `HonoServerPlugin` mounts it on, and the client's `fetch` hands each request to that app.
  - Signed in: exactly one `GET http://localhost:3000/api/v1/auth/me/permissions`. The resolved value parses through `MePermissionsResponseSchema` with no issues, and narrows on `authenticated` to the caller's own `userId`, `tenantId`, `hasAnyQueue` and `permissionSets`.
  - Anonymous: resolves `{ authenticated: false }` and does not throw.
  - The ledger row names `auth.mePermissions` and the schema these cases parse with.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit once, blob `3dc5d07f` → `9b262a18`): the row's route is renamed to `GET /auth/me/permissions-ablated`, and `client-url-conformance.test.ts` reds with 1 failed / 2 passed: `auth.mePermissions → GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions (via * /auth/**): expected 1 to be +0`. That is the failure this card was filed for, and the row is what closes it. Restore: blob equals HEAD's (`3dc5d07f`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The ledger is imported as relative source, so no build sits on the path.

## Acceptance notes

- **Which ledger.** The order's hypothesis was the runtime ledger. Measured: that file's SCOPE header describes dispatcher routes, and the dispatcher does not serve this path. But the file already holds rows for doors a plugin serves from the raw app, and its own conformance header names raw-app doors as rows it guards by census. plugin-auth's ledger cannot take the row: both halves are held to better-auth's live table and to `auth-plugin.ts`'s own mounts. A new plugin-hono-server ledger would be a sixth member of the client union with its own conformance gate. It would also have to give dispositions to `/auth/me/localization` and `/me/apps`, which no ledger carries today and this card does not ask about. So the row went into the runtime ledger, and its note says plainly that the door is a raw-app mount.
- `/auth/me/localization` and `/me/apps` (same registrar) stay in no ledger and have no client method. Not filed: no consumer asks for an SDK method for them.
- No console migration onto the method (order ruling); that is a follow-up of its own.
- Prior art: `ff0d7c02` (written and then reverted on #28508's branch) was reused for the method and its JSDoc. Its test used a mocked fetch; this one runs over the real handler instead.

## Verification

All at head `7ecb0017` (base `7a48bf73`, `origin/main` when the branch was cut).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client test`: Test Files 54 passed (54), Tests 693 passed (693).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck` over `tsconfig.test.json`, which covers the new test): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: 8 passed (8). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- Targeted: `auth-me-permissions`, `client-url-conformance`, `route-ledger-coverage`, `route-ledger-response-schema`, `auth-route-ledger-coverage`: 5 files, 16 passed (16).
- Dogfood (does not run in PR CI, so measured here after `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`): `route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts` 8 passed (8). With the new pin's key changed (ablation, blob `43b809da` → `d1fbf06f`): 2 failed / 6 passed. Direction 1 says `runtime/route-ledger.ts: GET /auth/me/permissions — LEDGERED BUT NOT MOUNTED` and the stale-pin check names the changed key. Restore: blob equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the four touched source files: exit 0.

</details>

- Three first readings were re-run once their prerequisite was in place. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone; after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876` it exited 0 (48 cases). `spec check:skill-examples` first exited 3 until `@objectstack/client-react` was built, then 0 (279 prose examples, 23 client SDK blocks). `check:dts-closure` first exited 1 because it ran while a closure build was still writing, then 0 (241/241 declaration files across 77 packages).
